backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a cloud storage system with file management, user profiles, access control, blob storage, notifications, sharing, favorites, trash with retention periods, activity logging, and admin quota management.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing summaries of frontend components and pages, describing routing, file management UI, admin features, hooks, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading the React app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component with TanStack Router setup, Internet Identity authentication flow, profile setup check, and theme provider wrapping all routes (Home, Dashboard, Admin, Settings, Trash).
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Card component displaying recent file activities in a scrollable list with icons, action badges, timestamps, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: Alert dialog for confirming permanent deletion of trash items with file count, total size display, optional secure wipe checkbox, and support for both single and bulk delete operations.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: Dialog for moving files to trash with configurable retention period selection (default 30 days or custom 30/60/90 days) and informational message about recovery.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: Dropdown menu component for filtering files by name, type, date range, and size range with active filter count badge and clear all functionality.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: Main file list component that displays files in grid or list view with search, filter, sort, preview, download, delete, and favorite functionality using custom hooks for data management.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: Modal component for previewing files with support for images, videos, PDFs, and text files, including download functionality and file metadata display.
Debounced search input component with clear button for filtering files by name or type with 300ms delay.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: Dropdown menu for sorting files by name, date, size, or type with ascending/descending order indicators and clear sort option.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: Toolbar component that combines search input, filter dropdown, sort dropdown, and grid/list view toggle buttons for file management.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: File upload component with drag-and-drop support, file selection, preview of selected files, and batch upload functionality with progress indication.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main application header component with navigation, search, theme toggle, notification bell with unread count badge, and user profile dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that combines Header and Sidebar with a toggleable sidebar state and renders child routes via Outlet.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a list of notifications with icons based on type (storage warning, share, activity, system), shows unread count badge, and allows marking individual notifications as read.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Shows horizontally scrollable favorite/pinned files with preview and download actions, records file access on interaction, and displays file preview modal.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form for new users to set up their profile with name and email fields before accessing the main application.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Dashboard quick action cards for uploading files, creating folders, and creating new text documents with gradient hover effects and file input handling.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, delete, restore) with action-specific icons and colors, showing file names and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: A dialog component for restoring deleted files from trash, allowing users to choose between restoring to original location or a custom folder path.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays files shared with the current user, showing file metadata, owner information, permissions, and providing preview/download actions with access tracking.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Navigation sidebar component with menu items for Home, My Files, Shared, Recent, Trash, Settings, and Admin (for admin users), plus a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Displays AI-powered file suggestions based on user activity, showing frequently accessed files with access counts, reasons, and preview/download actions.
A detailed storage usage dashboard card showing used/total storage with a progress bar, percentage, and color-coded warnings based on usage levels.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: A compact storage quota widget displaying used/total storage in MB with a progress bar and available space, designed for sidebar display.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filtering controls for trash view including search, file type, owner (admin only), date range, and original path filters with clear functionality.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Displays a card showing trash storage usage with a progress bar, percentage of total quota, and a message indicating how much storage can be reclaimed by emptying trash.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component that displays a table of all users with their storage usage, quotas, and usage percentages, allowing admins to edit user quotas via a dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor with authentication, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Provides file filtering functionality by name, type, date range, and size range with methods to set, clear, and apply filters to FileMetadata arrays.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Implements file search functionality that filters FileMetadata by name or extension based on a search query string.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Manages file sorting state and logic, supporting sorting by name, date, size, or type in ascending or descending order.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with idle handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, file management, storage quotas, trash operations, favorites, sharing, notifications, and admin functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors including primary, secondary, accent, destructive, and chart colors using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function that combines clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with role-based access control, displaying user management, storage stats, and activity feed components.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main user dashboard with toggle between file list view and upload view.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page displaying storage overview, quick actions, pinned files, recent activity, shared files, notifications, and smart suggestions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with Internet Identity authentication and feature highlights for the cloud storage platform.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page for managing account information, trash retention period, and theme preferences.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: Trash management page with sortable table, bulk operations, restore/delete functionality, and admin owner filtering support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and sessionStorage, supporting both regular and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with container settings, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata file indicating a file manager web application at version 10, marked as working correctly with no known issues or pending feature requests.
